environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the SQS consumer with standard JavaMail 1.6.2. Messages are encrypted with AES-256-GCM using AWS CloudHSM (FIPS 140-2 Level 3). The SQS queue has no message validation policy. Any authenticated IAM principal with sqs:SendMessage can publish arbitrary JSON payloads to the queue. SMTP relay is internal Postfix with no outbound content filtering.

config.hsm: AWS CloudHSM FIPS 140-2 Level 3, PKCS#11 provider
config.network: VPC with NAT gateway, outbound SMTP allowed on port 587
